worktree_policy.primary_checkout: Coordinator supplies verified absolute PRIMARY; workers never edit its project files or run app installs/tests there.
worktree_policy.creation: Agent creates its exclusive worktree/branch from verified origin/main before edits. Coordinator publishes /.worktrees/ ignore rule before T00. Resume only verified owned state; collisions block.
worktree_policy.execution: Rebase all paths to WT; use explicit cwd there for edits, local dependencies, tests, commits and pushes. Git metadata and DB/ports remain shared.
worktree_policy.cleanup: After REVIEW handoff, passing checks, clean state, stopped owned processes, durable evidence and verified remote HEAD, agent uses git worktree remove without force. Inspect ignored artifacts first. Keep local/remote branches. Preserve worktree on blockers/conflicts/failure; never prune or delete others' work.
